Share your thoughts on how people should handle conflict with a rival.

When dealing with a rival, it's important to stay calm and try to understand where they're coming from—sometimes a little empathy can go a long way. Instead of feeding the fire, maybe find a way to laugh at the whole thing or just let it all blow over like a summer storm. After all, most of these things are way too small for us to even care about, right? Just keep your head high and move on, because life's way too short for that kinda stuff!
